items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Quincy was the conductor of my band, and the soloist was Cannonball. ... Absolutely. You know who else was there that day?

ctx.x: Larry. All of them I.U. people.
I expected to see some Hawaiians, because Cannonball talked with the Seawind from Hawaii. I think just the drummer and the singer were Hawaiian.
Yeah, and the rest of them were from I.U.
